svg.title: Satori scan: one playbook run across every commit of a repository
svg.desc: A 17.5-second loop. A terminal runs satori-v2 scan acme/api satori://code/semgrep.yml -q 10 and prints Job 4127, type Scan, status Running. Below, a commit history timeline of the latest 10 commits of acme/api, oldest on the left and newest (HEAD) on the right. The same playbook, satori://code/semgrep.yml, travels across the timeline and runs on every commit: each node pulses blue while running, then turns green with a check (pass) or red with a cross (fail). Commits 1 to 3 pass; commits 4 to 6 (a41c9e2 feat: auth redirect, 5d73b18 refactor: session store, e902f6a feat: oauth login) fail, marked as a regression of 3 failing commits; commit 7 (7ac4d31 fix: XSS in auth) and the rest pass. A spotlight on a41c9e2, the first failure, shows assert semgrep.high assertStdoutNotContains ❯❯❱ failed with finding python.flask.security.xss.audit.explicit-unescape-with-markup in auth/views.py:42. A summary card reads Scan 4127 finished: 10 commits, 7 passed, 3 failed, broke in a41c9e2, fixed in 7ac4d31. Caption: One playbook. Every commit. See where assertions started failing in history.

g.text: See where assertions started failing in history.
